'''Mariineh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Mariineh was born on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and became the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Silmis Vey]]. During the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she was on the verge of becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and volunteered to go to [[Argul]] to [[Battle of Argul|battle]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].

==Behind the scenes==
Mariineh made her only appearance in ''[[Only the Force]]'', a scenario for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. In that, the player playing as Mariineh can choose Mariineh's sex. However, she is described as being female in the biographies of the other playable characters, so that can be assumed to be her canonical sex.
